method: 5 fresh browser contexts, same warm server/process and fixed synthetic dataset; no CPU throttling. Startup is BLPerf firstUsableInteractionMs, excluding reading the boot guide. CP 5000 in-memory canonical rows, normal pagination; two animation frames included. Not a Windows/Electron or cold-disk benchmark.
measurementNotes: The first attempt was discarded when a delayed release-note dialog intercepted navigation. The harness now waits up to 3 seconds for its normal close button before starting the CP timer.

In runs 4 and 5, firstUsableInteractionMs had not yet been committed at the initial snapshot. The same immutable startup metric is present in each later large.metrics snapshot (1042.3 ms and 858.3 ms). The summary uses these recorded values, never zero. No valid run was repeated. The harness now awaits the metric explicitly.
